name: project_visual_web_gallery
title: Project Visual Web Gallery
description: Web section of a project page (replaces section_web_project): primary title (block_title) ("Web Development") + optional content_section_primary components (e.g. project_block_visual_and_paragraph) + website galleries (web/desktop + web/phone, then web/content-website sub galleries), secondary title ("Web Media Content") + web/media-website images. Each part is a project_media_gallery; titles render only when something below them has output.
